newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to auction 7-yr bonds on March 13.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to auction 7-yr bonds on March 13.

text.p: Hungary will auction five billion forint worth of the seven-year government bonds of 2003/F series on March 13, the Government Debt Management Agency (AKK) said on Thursday.

NOTE - The bond bears a floating interest, calculated on February 20 and August 20 every year adding three percent to year-on-year consumer inflation. The interest is paid once a year, on March 12. The starting interest is 21.9 percent. -- Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
